defectsFoundThisSession.summary: An aggregate with no GROUP BY returns a row even when nothing matched, so a woman with no nearly-finished goal produced a nearly_there evidence row of NULLs.
defectsFoundThisSession.whyItMattered: The evidence set refuses a null confidence, so the whole assembly failed rather than quietly suggesting nothing.

defectsFoundThisSession.summary: Expiry was measured from midnight of the date rather than from assembly, so a twelve-hour suggestion assembled at 18:00 had expired six hours before it was made.
defectsFoundThisSession.whyItMattered: Nothing survived to be read; every recommendation vanished on the same request that created it.

defectsFoundThisSession.summary: The CI step for the recommendation assertions was authored with a shell capture bash evaluated at authoring time, leaving it empty.
defectsFoundThisSession.whyItMattered: The step would have passed unconditionally forever, reporting green for assertions it never ran.
defectsFoundThisSession.fix: Rewritten with the Edit tool; all 18 sqlcmd captures verified non-empty.

maturityNote: Up three from 54. Recommendation is the first engine that consumes every other one, and it does so through published interfaces with the assembly proven identical between the live path and simulation. Deployment, backups and monitoring remain at zero and the mobile client has still never been executed.

next.reason: Recommendations exist and carry their reasoning. The coach explains why one exists - it generates no advice, decides nothing and predicts nothing. It reads IntelligenceKeys.Recommendations and adapts tone from behaviour, state, life stage, energy, stress, momentum and goals.
next.constraint: Coach explains only. It must never assemble, infer or reassemble a recommendation; a coach that reassembled would be a second opinion about the same woman. Tone is configuration, not code.
scope: coach schema: tone rules and explanation templates as data
fn_ExplainFrom consuming a recommendation plus state, mirroring fn_AssembleFrom
SQL assertions incl. an explains-never-decides dependency assertion
inspector: coach explanation over simulated recommendations

architecturalInvariants: Recommend.fn_AssembleFrom is the ONLY assembly logic. It consumes an EvidenceSet and reads no raw store — verified by dependency graph. The live path and the Decision Inspector both feed it.

Behaviour.fn_Measure is the ONLY copy of the measure arithmetic. It consumes a DaySet and an HourSet and reads no per-user source — verified by dependency graph, not by text. The real observer and the Decision Inspector both feed it.
Behaviour.fn_Observe is the only computation of behaviour. Consumption goes through Behaviour.fn_Read and Behaviour.fn_ReadSteps.
Growth.Routine NEVER owns a step list. It references Behaviour.Subject. Asserted structurally: no Step/EventType/Percent column may exist on Growth.Routine.
Routine completion is derived from logged events every time. No stored percentage, no mark-complete command, no completion endpoint. Asserted at the contract boundary too.
Goal achievement is earned from the timeline, forward-only, and refused to clients by validator and procedure.
Applicability for content, dashboard cards, goals and routines all go through Rules.fn_Match. One matcher.
